review_candidates.description: About Us One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team. What You'll Do The Access Edge Platform team builds and operates the Wi-Fi and content experience used by passengers on the world's leading airlines. As a Staff Systems Engineer, you will own the engineering integrity of the platform across its full lifecycle - from requirements and architecture through implementation, verification, release, and field operation. Your work directly determines whether passengers stay connected and entertained at 35,000 feet. You will work closely with software engineers, hardware engineers, DevOps, product management, and airline customer teams, bridging disciplines that typically operate in isolation. This is a site‑based role, employees work 3+ days (60%+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five‑day workweek. The day-to-day Systems Engineering and Lifecycle Management Conduct system-level impact analyses for architectural and customer-specific changes before implementation. Own traceability across Product, Architecture, Development, Testing, and Release to ensure testing aligns with original intent, not just validating code. Manage configuration and variant management for different airline customers, aircraft platforms, and hardware generations, ensuring specific customer differences are well controlled. Establish release-readiness criteria and engineering quality gates with clear evidence, introducing lightweight governance to improve delivery quality while maintaining Agile practices. Develop engineering metrics to assess product health — such as incident recurrence, configuration complexity, traceability coverage, and release predictability — rather than focusing solely on delivery metrics. Cross-Team Engineering Integration Advocate for a system-level approach among engineering disciplines by ensuring that software, hardware, and operational constraints are considered collectively instead of in isolation. Drive engineering strategies to support multiple hardware generations - taking into account CPU, storage, and memory limitations - while balancing platform capabilities with customer commitments and long-term maintenance. Continuously identify architectural weaknesses, operational complexities, and engineering bottlenecks, prioritizing the platform's long-term health alongside new feature delivery. Hands-On Platform Engineering Earn the hands-on technical authority on system-level issues within our embedded Linux platform operating on two generations of edge servers, scrutinizing architecture, software design decisions, and hardware constraints firsthand. Lead in-depth investigations into the most complex field issues, including long-standing unresolved failures, by instrumenting running systems to ensure that these investigations conclude effectively. Promote engineering improvements post-incident that eliminate classes of failures, not individual defects, and create post-mortems focused on preventing future occurrences instead of implementing stopgap solutions Transform repetitive manual interventions into automated detection and self-healing processes, mitigating operational burdens and reducing customer escalations Enhance diagnostic skills across teams through mentorship, architecture-focused code reviews, and streamlined technical standards to ensure critical knowledge is distributed rather than held by a select few. Verification and Observability Define the engineering verification strategy across unit, integration, hardware-in-the-loop, and field validation — including test infrastructure that catches failure modes simulators do not model. Drive ground-side observability of fleet health so pre-failure signals surface before the system goes dark, and engineering decisions are based on data rather than opinion Ensure CI/CD and deployment pipelines are resilient to infrastructure events, and that deployment models prevent configuration drift across a large installed base of simultaneously active software versions What You'll Need Master's or Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience 15+ years of hands-on systems software engineering, with demonstrated Staff-level scope: architectural ownership, cross-team influence, and resolution of production incidents at the root-cause level Ability to rapidly understand complex platform technologies and become the technical owner of system-level problems across software, infrastructure, and embedded hardware - our current platform spans embedded Linux, distributed storage, Kubernetes-based workloads, wireless and authentication infrastructure, and low-level hardware interfaces Practical grounding in systems engineering discipline - requirements traceability, verification and validation, configuration management, and change impact analysis - applied pragmatically in fast-moving Agile product teams rather than as a heavyweight process Proven ability to instrument and analyze running distributed systems to close long-open field investigations at true root cause Experience defining verification strategy and test infrastructure for systems where hardware, software, and operational behavior interact - including hardware-in-the-loop or integration test environments Track record of reducing operational toil by converting repeated manual intervention into automated, self-healing systems Strong analytical skills - ability to read and reason about complex existing codebases and drive changes that reduce fragility Ability to communicate engineering risk, readiness, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and leadership What Will Help You On The Job Ability to navigate ambiguity while making the progress Instinct for finding patterns across unrelated incidents Architectural decisions to identify structural weaknesses Relentless focus on raising the system quality bar Salary range $180,500.00 - $285,000.00 / annually. Automation & Change Management: –Assist in maintaining basic automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)). –Adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, under guidance Core Responsibilities Planning & Execution: –Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. –Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance Collaboration & Partnership: –Collaborate within the team to better understand expectations and achieve shared objectives. –Leverage a foundational understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build partnerships with limited guidance. –Actively listen and ask questions to enhance collaboration. –Build a basic understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs with guidance. Continuous Learning: –Seek opportunities to gain knowledge and learn new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices. –Utilize feedback and training to improve skills. –Participate in a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing. Continuous Improvement: –Implement updates to processes, protocols, and workflows to increase efficiency and effectiveness as directed, with some guidance. –Contribute to ideation for future process improvements. review_candidates.title: Oracle Database Admin
review_candidates.description: Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced Oracle Database Admin , you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals. Work You'll Do/Responsibilities Administer Oracle databases across production, development, test, and disaster-recovery environments. Manage database configurations, schemas, tablespaces, indexes, partitioning, datafiles, listeners, redo logs, and archive logs. Implement and optimize Oracle GoldenGate replication, including Extract, trail files, Replicat, checkpoints, replication lag, and error resolution. Support high-availability and disaster-recovery architectures using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, ASM, and RMAN. Monitor and optimize database performance through SQL tuning, execution plans, AWR, ASH, and alert log analysis. Manage database security, including users, roles, privileges, access controls, and security patching. Respond to incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and execute database changes, upgrades, migrations, and maintenance activities. Develop automation scripts and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and recovery runbooks using SQL, PL/SQL, and shell scripting. The Team Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation. AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements. Our AI & Data practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively. Qualifications Required 4+ years of professional Oracle Database Administration experience, with a proven track record of supporting production of Oracle databases and business-critical applications in a client-facing or enterprise capacity. Experience with Oracle architecture, schemas, tablespaces, indexes, partitioning, RAC, Data Guard, ASM, and RMAN backup and recovery. Experience with Oracle GoldenGate replication and troubleshooting, along with database performance monitoring, PL/SQL, SQL tuning, and execution plan analysis. Proficiency with Linux or Unix operating systems and shell scripting. Preferred Professional Certifications: Active Oracle Database or related cloud infrastructure certifications. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. Experience with FSI organizations, Exadata, OEM, advanced GoldenGate tooling, database upgrades and migrations, AI/GenAI and RPA automation, and hybrid-cloud platforms such as OCI, AWS, or Azure. Ability to operate in controlled financial-services environments, including scheduled, on-call, and after-hours support; knowledge of SOX, PCI-DSS, GLBA, access reviews, and data privacy controls is preferred. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $113,000 to $188,400. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Platform Foundations
review_candidates.description: Summary The Cloud Platform Foundations team builds and operates the core infrastructure behind Temporal Cloud, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and automation . The team owns foundational systems including high availability and disaster recovery , control plane automation , resource and namespace management , and the customer-facing interfaces that shape how users integrate with the platform—from our APIs and CLI to the Terraform provider, SDKs, and Kubernetes operator. In this role, you'll build systems that directly strengthen Temporal Cloud's resilience, performance, and developer experience . You'll work closely with engineers and product managers to automate critical operations, evolve our multi-tenant control plane, reduce blast radius, improve namespace density, and build safer CI/CD pipelines. If you enjoy solving ambiguous, high-leverage infrastructure problems and creating durable tools that help both customers and engineers move faster, we'd love to meet you. What You'll Do High Availability & Disaster Recovery (HA/DR) — Enabling continuous regional failover and improving platform resilience. Control Plane Automation — Automating operations to improve reliability and developer efficiency. Database Performance and Optimization: Our data layer is scaling beyond its current limits. We need someone who can scale it by orders of magnitude while holding the line on latency, reliability, and availability. Deployment Plane: As our deploy frequency and engineering headcount both climb, we own redesigning the path from commit to production, drawing on strong infrastructure, deployment tooling, and systems design expertise. CI/CD for Control Plane — Building reliable pipelines for safer rollouts, faster iteration, and better test coverage. Technology Stack Primary Language: Go Data Storage: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redshift, S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage Data Processing: Kinesis, Firehose Infrastructure: Kubernetes Billing & Revenue: Metronome, Stripe Go-to-Market Integrations: Salesforce, Segment, Pylon, Zapier, cloud marketplace APIs Customer-Facing Standards: OpenMetrics, FOCUS Core Framework: Temporal (of course 😉) What You Can Expect High-impact ownership over systems tied directly to revenue, customer lifecycle, and platform scalability Collaborative engineering culture focused on quality, pragmatism, and measurable outcomes Exceptional technical colleagues and a feedback-rich environment Lean processes and autonomy without unnecessary bureaucracy Strong emphasis on reliability and operational excellence—balanced with rapid iteration A team that values mentorship, thoughtful design, and steady improvements that compound over time What You'll Bring Backend engineering experience with a cloud/infrastructure focus, ideally with some ops exposure — a blend of infra and database-driven systems. Experience on a control plane team for cloud-based microservices. Background building or operating multi-tenant SaaS applications. Familiarity with density-oriented cloud provider architectures. Strong Postgres (or similar relational database) experience. Track record designing for high availability, and managing compute and traffic at scale. Solid database chops, and a bias toward building rather than just configuring — you'd rather write the tool than click through one. CLI and DevOps fluency. Nice to Have - Exposure to data pipelining. Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity. Monitoring & Capacity Management Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, and service health. Implement proactive monitoring and alerting. Required Experience & Expertise Extensive hands-on enterprise infrastructure experience is essential. 8–12+ years of experience managing enterprise Windows infrastructure. 5+ years of strong hands-on experience with enterprise backup and disaster recovery. Strong troubleshooting experience across Windows, virtualization, storage, backup, and infrastructure environments. Strong understanding of server hardening, vulnerability management, security baselines, and access control. Educational Qualification Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering , or a related discipline. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered. Preferred Certifications Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or equivalent. VMware VCP or Microsoft Hyper-V certification. ITIL Foundation . Backup/DR certifications such as Veeam certifications.

Support regulatory and audit requirements appropriate for a SEC-regulated financial services firm (e.g., data residency, access controls, logging/retention). Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and grow the Cloud Platform team, including platform engineers, associate engineers, and contractors located in both US and India offices Build a talent pipeline and workforce plan to support growth—balancing FTE, contractor, and managed service resources. new_matches.description: Job Description As a Software Engineer on the Virtual Networking Gateways team, you will design, build, maintain, and test automation for provisioning, deploying, managing, and operating OCI virtual networking fleets. You will participate directly in fleet operations and change management. You will work primarily in Terraform and Python, contributing to our deployment pipelines. You will improve reliability by writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests as well as by creating and maintaining operational runbooks. You will manage your assigned work, maintain clear status in the team’s work-tracking system, and triage overlapping requests from partner service teams. This role requires the judgment to assess requests in the context of fleet scale, available capacity, operational risk, and cost; recognize when a request is disproportionate to the existing environment; and engage partner teams directly to clarify requirements and develop feasible approaches, escalating when appropriate. Candidates should have a foundational understanding of virtual networking and be comfortable owning well-scoped tasks with limited day-to-day direction. new_matches.title: Oracle Database Admin
new_matches.description: Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced Oracle Database Admin , you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals. Work You'll Do/Responsibilities Administer Oracle databases across production, development, test, and disaster-recovery environments. Manage database configurations, schemas, tablespaces, indexes, partitioning, datafiles, listeners, redo logs, and archive logs. Implement and optimize Oracle GoldenGate replication, including Extract, trail files, Replicat, checkpoints, replication lag, and error resolution. Support high-availability and disaster-recovery architectures using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, ASM, and RMAN. Monitor and optimize database performance through SQL tuning, execution plans, AWR, ASH, and alert log analysis. Manage database security, including users, roles, privileges, access controls, and security patching. Respond to incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and execute database changes, upgrades, migrations, and maintenance activities. Develop automation scripts and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and recovery runbooks using SQL, PL/SQL, and shell scripting. The Team Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation. AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements. Our AI & Data practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively. Qualifications Required 4+ years of professional Oracle Database Administration experience, with a proven track record of supporting production of Oracle databases and business-critical applications in a client-facing or enterprise capacity. Experience with Oracle architecture, schemas, tablespaces, indexes, partitioning, RAC, Data Guard, ASM, and RMAN backup and recovery. Experience with Oracle GoldenGate replication and troubleshooting, along with database performance monitoring, PL/SQL, SQL tuning, and execution plan analysis. Proficiency with Linux or Unix operating systems and shell scripting. Preferred Professional Certifications: Active Oracle Database or related cloud infrastructure certifications. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. Experience with FSI organizations, Exadata, OEM, advanced GoldenGate tooling, database upgrades and migrations, AI/GenAI and RPA automation, and hybrid-cloud platforms such as OCI, AWS, or Azure. Ability to operate in controlled financial-services environments, including scheduled, on-call, and after-hours support; knowledge of SOX, PCI-DSS, GLBA, access reviews, and data privacy controls is preferred. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $113,000 to $188,400. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

new_matches.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Platform Foundations
new_matches.description: Summary The Cloud Platform Foundations team builds and operates the core infrastructure behind Temporal Cloud, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and automation . The team owns foundational systems including high availability and disaster recovery , control plane automation , resource and namespace management , and the customer-facing interfaces that shape how users integrate with the platform—from our APIs and CLI to the Terraform provider, SDKs, and Kubernetes operator. In this role, you'll build systems that directly strengthen Temporal Cloud's resilience, performance, and developer experience . You'll work closely with engineers and product managers to automate critical operations, evolve our multi-tenant control plane, reduce blast radius, improve namespace density, and build safer CI/CD pipelines. If you enjoy solving ambiguous, high-leverage infrastructure problems and creating durable tools that help both customers and engineers move faster, we'd love to meet you. What You'll Do High Availability & Disaster Recovery (HA/DR) — Enabling continuous regional failover and improving platform resilience. Control Plane Automation — Automating operations to improve reliability and developer efficiency. Database Performance and Optimization: Our data layer is scaling beyond its current limits. We need someone who can scale it by orders of magnitude while holding the line on latency, reliability, and availability. Deployment Plane: As our deploy frequency and engineering headcount both climb, we own redesigning the path from commit to production, drawing on strong infrastructure, deployment tooling, and systems design expertise. CI/CD for Control Plane — Building reliable pipelines for safer rollouts, faster iteration, and better test coverage. Technology Stack Primary Language: Go Data Storage: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redshift, S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage Data Processing: Kinesis, Firehose Infrastructure: Kubernetes Billing & Revenue: Metronome, Stripe Go-to-Market Integrations: Salesforce, Segment, Pylon, Zapier, cloud marketplace APIs Customer-Facing Standards: OpenMetrics, FOCUS Core Framework: Temporal (of course 😉) What You Can Expect High-impact ownership over systems tied directly to revenue, customer lifecycle, and platform scalability Collaborative engineering culture focused on quality, pragmatism, and measurable outcomes Exceptional technical colleagues and a feedback-rich environment Lean processes and autonomy without unnecessary bureaucracy Strong emphasis on reliability and operational excellence—balanced with rapid iteration A team that values mentorship, thoughtful design, and steady improvements that compound over time What You'll Bring Backend engineering experience with a cloud/infrastructure focus, ideally with some ops exposure — a blend of infra and database-driven systems. Experience on a control plane team for cloud-based microservices. Background building or operating multi-tenant SaaS applications. Familiarity with density-oriented cloud provider architectures. Strong Postgres (or similar relational database) experience. Track record designing for high availability, and managing compute and traffic at scale. Solid database chops, and a bias toward building rather than just configuring — you'd rather write the tool than click through one. CLI and DevOps fluency. Nice to Have - Exposure to data pipelining. Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity. Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist. Compensation Range: $140.8K - $231K
